issues.concern: The English translation 'To say mean things' is too general and doesn't capture the nuance of '意地悪なことを言う' which implies saying things with malicious intent or to be spiteful.
The English translation 'I won't give up no matter what.' is too general and doesn't capture the nuance of '意地でも諦めない' which implies not giving up out of stubbornness or pride.
issues.suggestion: I won't give up, out of stubbornness/pride.
